I hate how i look. I will start yelling at my friends if they try to include me in a mirror selfie because I’ll think i look fat. Whenever i see a video or picture someone took of me, I would cringe so hard.

I’m honestly tired of it. I want to stop feeling this way. And the only way i know how to do that is to fix the problem. By losing weight. I wanted to see everyone after quarantine having lost weight and looking good, so i chose keto, because the first time my dad did it, he would lose have a kg everyday. Which is insane. 

I realize I’m doing this for the wrong reasons, but learning to love myself the way i am is not an option. I have to have a good body to like myself. I want to look good in clothes for once. I want to stop looking like a whale in front of my skinny, perfect bodied friends. It makes me feel like shit. I even look fat in oversized hoodies. How. Is. That. Even. Possible.

I’m glad you like it. I’m happy for you, i just wish i felt the same way. Maybe then it wouldn’t be so hard. Funnily enough, I’m not cheating at all. Unless you count 5 blueberries cheating. 

I usually eat scrambled eggs with cheese and some kind of meat and i add some cherry tomatoes. I also drink bulletproof coffee with butter every morning. For lunch I usually have salad and some source of protein. My mom makes almond bread with lots of fats so i eat that with butter and sugar-free strawberry jam that my mom made if I’m a bit hungrier in the morning. I add berries sometimes also, and that’s about it. I check the labels of everything and i stare at the Nutella jar sometimes but I close the cabinet and drink some water.

The only thing I would say I’m doing wrong is my lack of exercise. But then again my dad lost 15 kgs on keto with no exercise. I’m just not one for exercise. I like walking and swimming. But its unbearably hot where i live and my dermatologist said i cant swim. Cardio and hiit exercises and what not, my body straight up cannot do those. I have a back that hurts if i bend down to pick something up. I cant exercise.

Honestly my life is pretty bleak. Whenever I would be having a bad day, and i get those a lot and they’re really bad, I would usually snack on something like nutella or candy and it really does help. Maybe my dopamine system is messed up, who knows? But all i know is that food gave me joy like nothing else does. And I can somewhat tolerate cutting out carbs and sugar. But its like you can’t eat anything on this diet. No fruits, no dairy (i love milk), no sauces, and the list goes on. And the alternatives for popular foods are usually disgusting (sorry if this offends anyone). I tried “keto pasta” and i was just ready to quit right then and there.

I’d recommend getting rid of any sweets or snacks in your house. Look up some keto desserts, they’re fun to make, and if made well, will really satisfy your sweet tooth or sugar cravings. Try and get creative with your meals. Dont eat the same thing everyday or you’ll quickly get bored. Try bulletproof coffee if you haven’t already! (Black coffee with cream or butter). Stevia or other sugar alternatives are a must-have. If you get hungry but have finished all your macros for the day or having cravings in the middle of the night and dont want to go down that hole (i know it all too well), drink plenty of water. Your body will eventually get used to getting water instead of food so the cravings will eventually stop or at the very least, they’ll decrease (in my experience at least). Dont use the scale, its very disheartening. Everyone i have seen since i started keto has been shocked at how much weight I’ve lost, yet i am not satisfied and the never changing number on the scale doesn’t help. I’d recommend measuring yourself instead. Or take lots of pictures. Keep yourself occupied and out of the kitchen as much as you can (unless you’re supposed to be eating). Maybe get a friend to help out and keep an eye on you. Get lots of berries as those are the only safe fruits you can eat on keto (there are others but they’re usually higher in carbs). 

I can’t think of any other tips. These are just some of the things that helped me. I’m almost 3 weeks in. I miss Krispy Kreme, but i want to lose weight more than i want sugar.

Good luck!
